articles.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
articles.description: [daily.dev] A roundup covers AI assistants that operate through text messaging (iMessage, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Telegram) rather than standalone apps, letting users delegate tasks like scheduling, email, bookings, and research. Entries span general-purpose assistants (Instinct, Poke, Martin, Rene, Folk, Caddy), family-focused tools (Fambot, Ohai, Ollie, Orbits), niche assistants (Miso for travel, Stanley for content creation, Town for professional work, Wajo's Fo), and others like Iris, Skye, Pally, and Tomo. Pricing, funding rounds, and launch dates for each are noted, with Instinct highlighted as the buzz [poweredbyai.app] Rather than downloading another app, a growing number of agents can simply be texted like an ordinary person. You text it what you need, and it can remember context, connect to the apps and services you already use, and complete tasks on your behalf. That can mean scheduling an appointment, organizing a calendar, researching a trip, sending an email, making a reservation, shopping online, or reminding you about something days later. items.title: An OpenAI safety employee has quit and is sounding the alarm
items.summary: OpenAI前安全主管David Robinson辞职并在大西洋月刊发文，称公司文化已彻底破裂。
items.why_it_matters: 资深员工公开质疑表明内部安全机制可能失效，加剧行业对AI治理的担忧。

items.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
items.summary: OpenAI长期负责安全报告的员工辞职，指责硅谷盲目追求模型规模忽视风险。
items.why_it_matters: 该事件揭示了硅谷激进开发模式与AI安全需求之间的深层矛盾及潜在隐患。

items.title: Capcom is preparing for a ‘future where we create games together with AI’
items.summary: 卡普空计划将RE引擎演变为AI生成游戏引擎，目标是未来与AI共同制作游戏。
items.why_it_matters: 这一战略转向意味着游戏开发流程将深度整合AI工具，重塑行业生产范式。

items.title: Splice CEO Kakul Srivastava thinks AI emails are killing conversations
items.summary: Splice首席执行官认为AI生成的邮件正在扼杀人与人之间的真实沟通对话。
items.why_it_matters: 音乐产业高管的批评反映了AI自动化沟通对创意协作生态的潜在负面影响。

items.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs | TechCrunch
items.summary: 亚马逊AWS宣布在与政府机构协商数据中心项目时不再使用保密协议。
items.why_it_matters: 此举旨在回应公众对数据中心环境影响的质疑，试图重建社区信任关系。

items.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
items.summary: 多款AI代理可直接通过短信应用运行，用户无需下载独立应用即可委托任务。
items.why_it_matters: 这种交互模式降低了AI使用门槛，推动智能助手向更自然的日常通讯场景渗透。

items.title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
items.summary: Meta开源代码允许开发者利用ESP32或树莓派自行构建搭载Muse的智能硬件设备。
items.why_it_matters: 开放硬件生态有助于加速AI Agent在边缘设备的落地，激发开发者创新活力。

items.title: AI hallucinations are making entitled customers even worse
items.summary: AI幻觉导致顾客提出不存在的产品需求，使一线服务人员面临更多无理投诉。
items.why_it_matters: 技术误报引发的客户行为异化增加了服务业运营难度，凸显人机协作的现实挑战。
